cs.t: I recently switched to opnsense on bare metal on an N105 with dual 2.5g NIC, after having been quite happy for many years running a bunch of Asus routers on Merlin. My main goals were to improve throughput and security. Opnsense seems to work well OOTB, but being a dilettante in these matters I must admit to having a nagging anxiety that I may have misconfigured something important. Any recommendations for a reliable way to check that?
